profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Engineer with experience in hardware and software development. Skilled in RF, Embedded Systems, Python, C/C++, Assembly (Intel 8086, PIC, and 6811/12) and Databases (such as SQLite). Strong engineering professional with a Master of Science focused in Electrical Engineering from Texas A&M University-Kingsville.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Work in a small team to develop in-house applicationfor validation and as well as automated testing of mmWave RFICs
o Work on 5G FR2 standards primarily, also develop controls for radar chipset tests
o In-house tool controls and configures all the test hardware (supporting multiple vendors such as Keysight, Rhode & 
Schwartz and National Instruments)
o Adding EVM, ACP, CHP, as well as current measurement capabilities.
o Device controls for DUT is primarily register read/writes, however sometimes AT commands as well
o Develop documentation for internal and external customers
o Deploy application to production testing (sometimes involve traveling to Japan and Korea)
o Implemented of SSH client, TCP/IP client and server, RS-232 serial communication, and TFTP server for in-house 
application to communicate with various DUTs
▪ On Raspberry Pi (to emulate DUT for testing) implemented RS-232 (via UART) and TFTP client
▪ Using Event-drive concepts also implemented logging capabilities for in-house application
o Implemented plug-ins architecture in C# to allow rapid development and integration of new RFICs
o Using HAL concepts implemented interface and support for various instruments
• In Linux, implemented 8 channels rf playback of modulated waveforms for NI USRP-x440, with phase alignment on all 
channels in python based application
o Each channel plays different waveforms (for radar application)
• Developed several python scripts to work with dataset from Excel, CSV, TDMS (NI) and binary files
o Worked with pandas, npTDMS libraries for python 2.7 and 3.11
• Working remotely (from home) for office in San Diego, successfully able to communicate with teammates and getting tasks done remotely with some travel
positions.insights: Skills: Software Development · C# · Radio Frequency (RF)

positions.title: Principal RF Systems and Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Helped architect and develop product for RF measurement solution for multi-DUT testing
o	Developed code generation in C# for encapsulating methods available in NI RFmx measurements
o	Mentored and tech lead junior engineers
o	Worked with management to ensure on-time deliveries for on-going customer engagements
•	Developed and architected record and playback application for NI USRP-x310 software defined radios with client/server interactions in Linux using combination of C++ and Python programming languages
•	Developed DUT controls using RS232, TCP/IP, or Telnet protocols for Cellular and WLAN devices
o	Worked with cellular chipsets to test GSM, WCDMA and LTE standards
o	Worked with WLAN chipsets to test 802.11a,b,g,n, and ac standards
o	Developed several automated tests based on test plans to measure EVM, ACP, OBW, and SEM for transmitters and BER for receiver sensitivity
•	Developed Hardware Abstraction Layer (HAL) for Instrument controls in C# .NET for instruments such as Keysight EXM and NI Wireless Test System
•	Worked with GNSS emulator (Skydel SDx) for testing and validating navigation receivers
•	Responsible for developing proof of concepts
o	Developed POC for SCPI instrument control in Linux via Python
o	Developed POC with USRPs software defined radios in Linux environment for streaming IQ data
o	Developed instrument server using NI VST and RFmx in C# .NET and WCF .NET library to be used over TCP/IP

positions.title: Senior RF Systems Engineer
positions.description: RF Test Systems and Software Development as well as Consultation.

positions.title: R&D Research Staff Engineer
positions.description:
Research Staff Member for Power and Energy System.
Implemented Curve ZeroMQ protocol on Raspberry PI, Ubuntu and Windows OS in Python.
Implemented DNP3 protocol (using OpenDNP3) on Raspberry PI and Ubuntu using C++.
Implemented DNP3 data transaction to Python from C++ and in reverse direction via SQLite and PIPEs in Ubuntu and Raspberry PI.

positions.title: Staff RF V&V Engineer
positions.description:
Validation and verification engineer in the RF Test and Measurements group.
Assist manufacturing in release of product (overseas travel to Malaysia).
Develop automated testing and collect and analyze data using LabVIEW and Python.
Developed automated test for production.
Contributed to the release of PXIe-5840 and PXIe-5820.
Received Engineering Excellence Award for RF for contribution in release of product.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Develop drivers for Windows OS for RF Products.
Responsible for kernel development, testing and debugging.
Primary programming language used C\C++.

positions.title: Staff RF Product Support Engineer
positions.description:
Sole software developer on a driver project
Driver development in C++, added features to NI-5690 v14.5 driver (signal conditioning modules)
In-charge of regression testing and creating test for new features
Represent the RF Signal Generators, NI USRP, and RF FAMs to Applications Engineers, large customers and R&D
Manage quality and customers escalations

positions.title: RF Product Support Engineer
positions.description:
Represent the RF Signal Generators, NI USRP, and RF FAMs to Applications Engineers, large customers and R&D
Manage quality and customers escalations
Responsible for editing technical documentation for RF product line
Built application to automate P1dB measurements for multiple DUT testing for a given frequency range
Implemented gain correction for system calibration of NI PXI-5600 RF downconverter using LabVIEW
Lead in the creation of RF Attenuator calibration procedure on NI PXI 5695 
	Detailed procedures for performing the needed Gain and VSWR measurements
	Detailed calculations needed to achieve the calibration coefficients from the measurements above
Lead in the creation of RF Amplifier characterization and calibration procedures.
	Detailed procedures for performing the needed Gain, Noise Figure, IIP3, and VSWR measurements
	Detailed the calculations needed to achieve the calibration coefficients

positions.title: Application Engineer
positions.description:
Provided customer support for RF, High Speed Modular Instruments, and Data Acquisition product line
Created proof of concept for playing back recorded signal via Arbitrary Waveform Generator
Created a proof of concept for measuring Adjacent Channel Power, Peak Power, Occupied Bandwidth and Average Power using RF Hardware and LabVIEW
Developed training material for Data Acquisition product line for internal hires
Developed a waterfall spectrogram demo using LabVIEW and LabVIEW FPGA and implemented with PXIe-5673E,5663E, and PXIe-7965R for NI Week 2012
Create a proof of concept for triggering RF acquisition and spectrum display application, and implemented using CVI\LabWindows

positions.title: Computer Secialist
positions.description:
Designed, implemented and maintained company website using ASP .NET and HTML
Developed Property management system for Hotel sales and transaction using VB .NET and SQLite

positions.title: Electrical Engineering Student Coop
positions.description:
Participated in NASA and Texas A&M University-Kingsville joint project for a Balloon Satellite
Designed and built 15 dBi quad-loop antennas for frequencies in the 2-meter band
Implemented RS-232 interfaces for GPS and various instruments
Developed the firmware for master control unit on board of the satellite using Motorola 68HC12 in assembly language
Designed and built +/- 12 VDC power supply for an analog multiplexer
Designed and fabricated a PCB for an analog switch for various interfaces
